sources.search_query: United Arab Emirates official government tourist visa entry requirements u.ae visa-free nationalities
sources.relevant_excerpt: The tourist visa is available to those ineligible for visa-free entry or visa-on-arrival options. Applicants can obtain tourist visas through: the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (online); UAE-based airlines (Etihad, Emirates, Fly Dubai); licensed travel agents and hotels; and the General Directorate of Identity and Foreigners Affairs - Dubai. The UAE's embassies do not issue tourist visas. The 5-year multiple entry tourist visa allows visitors to enter the UAE multiple times on self-sponsorship and remain in the country for 90 days on each visit, extendable for a further 90 days; it requires a bank balance of 4,000 USD or its equivalent during the last six months, a valid health insurance policy applicable in the UAE valid for 180 days, and a ticket showing a continuing or return journey from the UAE.

sources.relevant_excerpt: GCC Citizens: No visa required; present GCC passport or ID card at entry. EU & Associated Nations (6-month passport validity), up to 90 days in any 180-day period: Sweden, Austria, Malta, Poland, The Netherlands, Portugal, Norway, Lithuania, Germany, Switzerland, Hungary, Latvia, Italy, France, Denmark, Slovakia, Spain, Greece, Estonia, Croatia, Luxembourg, Belgium, Finland, Iceland, Slovenia, Romania, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Czech, Liechtenstein, and Montenegro. Other Exempt Nations (30-day maximum): United States of America, Australia, New Zealand, United Kingdom, Monaco, Singapore, Malaysia, Brunei, San Marino, Canada, Japan, Korea, Vatican, Andorra, Hong Kong, Ireland, Russia, Bahamas, and Republic of India. Reciprocal Exemptions (ordinary passports, 30 days): Seychelles, Bahamas, Argentina, and China. Indian passport holders with valid EU/British residence permits receive 30-day exemptions. Fees: Tourist Visa 100 AED + 10 AED delivery (30 days); Short Visit 500 AED + 10 AED delivery (30 days); Long Visit 1,000 AED (90 days); Multiple Entry 2,000 AED (6 months, max 14 days per entry). Passport must be valid at least six months.

sources.search_query: official UAE embassy Washington visas US citizens
sources.relevant_excerpt: A visa will be issued upon entry, allowing a maximum stay of 90 days non-renewable, whether continuously or intermittently, within 180 days calculated from the date of first entry. Travelers must have a valid passport that will last at least six months beyond your expected arrival date in the UAE. A fine of 50 AED will be imposed for each day exceeding the 90 days allowed for staying in the country.
